overall: No violation found. Only two of the five members attended the June 13 informational session, a sub-quorum, so it was not a deliberation requiring posted notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission failed to post notice of its June 13 parent information night, which a Facebook post had advertised.
allegations.key_passage: A sub-quorum of a body’s members may communicate on matters within its jurisdiction outside of a meeting and such discussion would not constitute a deliberation under the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
